WITH RECURSIVE CTE AS ( -- 1. 루트 노드 조회 (START WITH PARENT_GROUP_ID = '0') SELECT GROUP_ID AS "groupId", GROUP_NM AS "groupNm", GROUP_CREAT_DE AS "groupCreatDe", PARENT_GROUP_ID AS "parentGroupId", USEYN AS "useYn", 1 AS "lv", ARRAY[ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY GROUP_ID)] AS sort_path FROM LETTNAUTHORGROUPINFO WHERE USEYN = 'Y' AND PARENT_GROUP_ID = '0'
AND GROUP_ID LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
AND GROUP_NM LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
UNION ALL
-- 2. 자식 노드 재귀 조회 (CONNECT BY PRIOR) SELECT T.GROUP_ID AS "groupId", T.GROUP_NM AS "groupNm", T.GROUP_CREAT_DE AS "groupCreatDe", T.PARENT_GROUP_ID AS "parentGroupId", T.USEYN AS "useYn", C."lv" + 1 AS "lv", C.sort_path || ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY T.GROUP_ID) FROM LETTNAUTHORGROUPINFO T INNER JOIN CTE C ON T.PARENT_GROUP_ID = C."groupId" WHERE T.USEYN = 'Y'
AND T.GROUP_ID LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
AND T.GROUP_NM LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY sort_path) AS "rnum", TB."groupId", TB."groupNm", TB."groupCreatDe", TB."parentGroupId", CASE WHEN TB."parentGroupId" = '0' THEN '2' ELSE ( SELECT B.GROUP_NM FROM LETTNAUTHORGROUPINFO B WHERE B.GROUP_ID = TB."parentGroupId" ) END AS "parentGroupNm", TB."useYn", TB."lv" FROM CTE TB

SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM LETTNAUTHORGROUPINFO WHERE 1=1
AND GROUP_ID LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
AND GROUP_NM LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'

WITH RECURSIVE CTE AS ( SELECT GROUP_ID AS "groupId", 1 AS lv, GROUP_NM AS "groupNm", PARENT_GROUP_ID AS "parentGroupId" FROM LETTNAUTHORGROUPINFO WHERE USEYN = 'Y' AND PARENT_GROUP_ID = #{parentGroupId}
AND (PARENT_GROUP_ID = #{groupId} OR GROUP_ID = #{groupId})
UNION ALL
SELECT T.GROUP_ID AS "groupId", C.lv + 1, T.GROUP_NM AS "groupNm", T.PARENT_GROUP_ID AS "parentGroupId" FROM LETTNAUTHORGROUPINFO T INNER JOIN CTE C ON T.PARENT_GROUP_ID = C."groupId" WHERE T.USEYN = 'Y' ) SELECT * FROM CTE
